Snippets are source-derived and labelled; not executed locally outside the showcase demo.

modern-web-guidance responsive-table applied: semantic thead/th + .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;max-inline-size:100%} wrapper on every table; pre{overflow-x:auto}; overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1/lede/code; iframe max-width:100%. Verified by headless-Chrome screenshots at 1280px and 360px read during the build (no horizontal page overflow, tables scroll within their wrappers).

All three CPS concept routes HEAD-checked 200 on 2026-10-04; reason-everywhere embedded (it surfaces the reason at all four read sites, directly demonstrating the page's subject), timeout-vs-user and streaming-download linked in the figcaption; feature route linked in see-also.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation compat table horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic <thead>/<th> foundation; wrap tables in a wrapper with overflow:auto and max-inline-size:100% so overflow scrolls inside the wrapper instead of the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: every table uses thead or th scope=row and sits inside .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;max-inline-size:100%}. Sticky headers and container-query stacking were not adopted: these are short reference tables, not large scrolling data grids — targeted exception.

guidanceConsulted.query: code block pre overflow mobile readable documentation page
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Control where overflow is handled rather than letting content clip or widen the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: pre{overflow-x:auto} keeps long IDL/code lines scrollable within the block; overflow-wrap:anywhere on headings, lede and inline code prevents viewport overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation compat table horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer intrinsic sizing and logical properties for responsive components.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: max-inline-size on the table wrapper; layout otherwise inherits the shared /public/styles.css design system (no new layout primitives introduced).
